evidence: Authored in the Video Studio repository and merged there through pull request 47 with 240 backend tests, 25 browser scenarios and a boundary check passing.
The reading-time checker and loudness gate are covered by that repository's test suite, including a synthetic FFmpeg render and a fake agent turn verifying the work-directory install.
The checker was run against a real 23 second launch cut and against its earlier 21 second draft; it flagged the draft's over-budget scene and nine-word outro and passed the delivered cut.
limitations: No independent full-bundle review of this catalog copy has been performed; status is experimental until one is recorded.
The scripts were validated on macOS with FFmpeg 8; other platforms are untested.
The tone presets map to Video Studio's five brief workflows and may need a preset for other brief shapes.
